questions.question_text: Use the formal algorithm to calculate $312 \times 3$.

options.why: The ones digit must be $6$, since $2\times3=6$. The tens and hundreds give $3$ and $9$, so the product is $936$.
Reversed the product digits after working from right to left.
The tens digit should be $3$ and the ones digit $6$, giving $936$, not $915$.

questions.question_text: Use the formal algorithm to calculate $58 \times 7$.

options.why: Forgot to add the carried 5 to the tens-column product.
The ones digit should be $6$, from $8\times7=56$, not $1$.
The ones digit must be $6$. Adding the carried $5$ to $5\times7$ gives $40$ tens, so the product is $406$.
The tens column gives $2+(6\times6)=38$, so write $8$ and carry $3$. The final column gives $45$, not $42$.
The tens digit should be $8$, from $2+(6\times6)=38$. Carrying $3$ gives $3+(7\times6)=45$ in the final column.
Added one extra hundred when combining the final carry.

questions.question_text: Use the formal algorithm to calculate $3027 \times 4$.

options.why: Failed to carry 2 from the ones column into the tens column.
Inserted an extra zero for the zero hundreds digit.
The tens column gives $2+(2\times4)=10$: write $0$ and carry $1$. The zero hundreds digit still receives that $1$.
Using $4$ gives $446\times5=2230$, not $2280$.
Using $6$ gives $466\times5=2330$, not $2280$.
Copied the tens digit of the final product into the missing place.

questions.question_text: In $689 \times 7$, what happens immediately after calculating $9 \times 7=63$?

options.text: Write $3$ in the ones column and carry $6$
Write $6$ in the ones column and carry $3$
options.why: Reversed the two digits of $63$, writing the tens digit and carrying the ones digit.

options.text: Write $3$ in the ones column and discard $6$
options.why: Recorded the ones digit but lost the $6$ tens that must be carried into the tens column.

options.text: Write $6$ in the ones column and discard $3$
options.why: Reversed the two digits of $63$ and also lost the digit that should have been carried.

questions.solution_text:
$9 \times 7=63$.
Write $3$ in the ones column and carry $6$ to the tens column.
